name: green-f5m-sr-levels-all-sessions
note: G1 design §10 -- the acceptance demonstration. This is the SHIPPED indicators/openscript/f5m-sr-levels.os, verbatim, after terminate.new_session collapsed its two mutually exclusive output sets into one: 30 level outputs became 15, the timeframe-dependent `bars=73` constant is gone, and with it the bug class where two sets that were not exactly exclusive drew and labelled the same session twice. Four IST sessions of five 5-minute bars. Every one of the 15 outputs is pinned across EVERY session, not just the newest: each spawns on its session's second bar (windowBars=1, so the window closes after bar 1) at 1/6/11/16, closes on its own session's LAST bar at 4/9/14, and the live session's object rides the live edge open at lastBarIndex=19. A 4-item expectation cannot be satisfied by the first conversion's bug 2, where a session reset true for every intraday bar spawned exactly once for the whole dataset. Non-window bars carry highs 50 above and lows 50 below the window's, so an over-capturing opening window moves every price. Labels are pinned on every session too: a level's label is a right-edge tag anchored at x2, so under the old extend.lastbar history set all 20 sessions' tags piled into one column and the port had to hide all but the newest with label_latest_only; per-session termination gives each session its own x2 and the tags spread out.
